Lines 73-79 — cachedForemen useEffect also calls setForemen(cachedForemen) so an in-memory cache hit instantly populates the select on tab remount.

The 'me' refinement at line 109-111 only narrows the list when /foreman/me succeeds; on failure the unfiltered allF stays in state.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (foremen-select pusty po wielu przekazaniach): in the previous version of EquipmentForeman.js fetchAll(), setForemen() was called only AFTER awaiting the full SECONDARY Promise.all([/equipment/transfers/pending, /foreman/me, ...]). Because /equipment/transfers/pending had no .catch and could throw 4xx/5xx (especially after many transfer rows pile up — pagination/size limits or DB hiccups), the SECONDARY await rejected and the whole try-block jumped to catch. PRIMARY data WAS already fetched but setForemen was never invoked, so the foremen state remained the previous [] (or empty after navigation) — user saw '-- wybierz --' only. Fix in iter95ay (verified lines 88-96, 101-105): (1) setForemen(allF) executed synchronously right after PRIMARY succeeds; (2) every SECONDARY call wrapped in .catch returning a safe default; (3) cached-data useEffect (lines 73-79) also seeds setForemen so re-mount paints instantly. Result: foremen-select is now guaranteed non-empty as long as /foremen returns >=1 foreman, independent of any SECONDARY failure.
